# Redis Development

Skills that teach agents to work with Redis Development. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [redis/agent-skills](https://github.com/redis/agent-skills), at commit `a84871d`.

Redis development best practices — data structures, query engine, vector search, caching, and performance optimization

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Redis Development**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Redis Development**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install redis-development@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

8 skills: `iris-development`, `redis-clustering`, `redis-connections`, `redis-core`, `redis-observability`, `redis-search`, `redis-security`, `redis-semantic-cache`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.

The skills mention these environment variables for credentials: `COHERE_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`. This plugin does not store them.

## Docs
